description: Add or subtract days, weeks, months or years from any date. Optional business-days-only mode skips weekends automatically.

faqs.a: It steps forward or backward one calendar day at a time, skipping Saturdays and Sundays, until the requested number of business days is reached. Public holidays are not accounted for.

faqs.q: What happens adding months to Jan 31?
faqs.a: The result is clamped to the last valid day of the target month — Jan 31 plus one month gives Feb 28 (or Feb 29 in a leap year).
No. Adding 1 day to Monday gives Tuesday. The count starts from the day after (or before) the start date.

howto: Pick the start date (defaults to today).
Choose add or subtract, enter an amount and pick days, weeks, months or years.
Tick “business days only” to skip weekends (works with days).
Read the resulting date, its weekday and how far it is from today.
title: Add / Subtract Days Calculator
